items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: when Ted left the band, Lucky Thompson came in behind him. Lucky did it. Herbie Field come in behind him.

ctx.x: But when we got through with it, we broke the house out. And he said, sa-a-sa-sa-sa-a, keep that in. And we kept it in. And it -- when Ted left the band, Lucky Thompson came in behind him. Lucky did it. Herbie Field come in behind him. He did it. And right on -- when Johnny Griffin come in, we fought on, and he's a little fizen, and I'm big 200 -- (inaudible). See how big I am? And Johnny's a little guy, and I'm stomping my feet at him, and he's little, like a little fizser, but he's blowing. Cracked it up. But…
Hamp didn't want to get rid of us.
